annotations.title: Solana Wallet Balances: SOL and Token Holdings with USD Values

description: SOL balance and token holdings of any Solana address, with symbols, USD prices and values, largest first. Sums multiple accounts of the same token and includes Token-2022 tokens. Public on-chain data and market prices; not advice. Very large wallets are limited to the most valuable holdings. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

limit.description: Number of holdings to return, most valuable first.
